title: Virendra Verma v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Tarun Agarwala, J.; Vipin Sinha, J.
disposition: Writ connected; recovery citation stayed pending challenge to cl. 4.3(f)(v).
headnote: On a writ against a recovery citation, the Allahabad High Court connected the petition with Writ-C No. 8370 of 2016, in which clause 4.3(f)(v) of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was under challenge, issued notice to the Advocate General and respondent no. 7, and directed that the recovery citation shall not be enforced against the petitioner, while leaving the respondents free to recover the dues from respondent no. 7.
facts: Virendra Verma invoked the writ jurisdiction of the Allahabad High Court against a recovery citation issued for electricity dues. The petition was connected with Writ-C No. 8370 of 2016, in which clause 4.3(f)(v) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 stood challenged. Notice issued to the Advocate General and respondent no. 7. The Court stayed enforcement of the recovery citation against the petitioner, while leaving the respondents free to recover the dues from respondent no. 7.

holding_units.topic: challenge to cl. 4.3(f)(v); interim stay of recovery citation
holding_units.holding: Noting that clause 4.3(f)(v) of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was under challenge in connected Writ-C No. 8370 of 2016, the Court connected this writ, issued notice to the Advocate General and respondent no. 7, and directed that the recovery citation shall not be enforced against the petitioner, while leaving it open to the respondents to recover the dues from respondent no. 7.

not_decided.point: Validity of clause 4.3(f)(v) of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005
not_decided.note: The clause was under challenge in the connected writ; notice issued to the Advocate General; no decision on validity.

not_decided.point: Merits of the recovery citation against the petitioner
not_decided.note: Only interim non-enforcement was directed; dues left recoverable from respondent no. 7.
